title: Document triage
description: Classify an incoming document, say how urgent its handling is, and judge whether it needs a human step. The score axis is urgency like every other domain: the generator's phrase banks are tone-shaped (calm → urgent), so a confidence axis would label urgent text with a confidence level. Documented as a design decision in BACKLOG B-5.

option_descriptions.invoice: Rechnungen, Quittungen, Bestellungen, Spesenabrechnungen und Zahlungsbedingungen
option_descriptions.other: alles andere: Lebensläufe, Richtlinien, interne Notizen, Pressemitteilungen und Bürohinweise
option_descriptions.report: Berichte, Tabellenkalkulationen, Präsentationen, Audits, Prognosen und Analyseunterlagen
